name: Kimon P. Valavanis
title: John Evans Professor; Professor; Founding Director, Unmanned Systems Research Institute
fitReason: Concrete sim-to-real neural-policy flight-control work and independent research-supervision linkage, with current university/institute appointment.

physicalEvidence.summary: The published 2025 Drones study deploys a simulation-trained DDPG actor directly on Pixhawk2.1 Cube Black to select bounded PD attitude gains during real outdoor quadrotor flight. It reconstructs the trained neural inference as generated C++; the flight-time adaptation changes controller gains, not necessarily neural weights. The benchmark is a single circular trajectory against manually tuned PD, with formal stability/robustness analysis left for future. The newer PD article supersedes the broader PID preprint wording. Exact experiment site and current visitor equipment access are not established. Lead author Sönmez’s 2024 Denver PhD independently links the project lineage to the two advisers, but the 2025 paper credits these senior coauthors with editing/advisory contributions; physical credit is conservatively capped at 20.

shortVisit.summary: No current external-master short-visit invitation verified in inspected faculty/research sources. The university’s Fall 2023 Fulbright professor visit to Valavanis is useful hosting precedent, not a current student offer.
